attribution: Festival dates follow the lunar and solar calendars and move from year to year; the month given is the one each usually falls in. Every item is drafted from the sources it lists and awaits review.
_regions: The states and union territories that keep it, or "*" for one kept the country over.
_anchor: The one place a festival is most seen at -- Onam at Thrissur, the Hornbill at Kisama -- so the map has somewhere to draw it. It must fall in one of the item's regions, or anywhere in India for one kept the country over.
